mentions.name: Mighty
mentions.description: This library lets you render Astro components everywhere, building on Astro's Container API. It provides Vite integration with local dev and hot reload, styling support, a simple way to import Astro components, and backend adapters for Hono and Laravel at first release.
mentions.problem: Astro historically lacked a renderToString-style API for server rendering; the newer Container API still has rough edges: importing components is a hassle, there is no Vite integration (no local dev or hot reload), and no styling support.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building Mighty, a library that lets you render Astro components everywhere.
